caption:
How do I prepare my skin before a treatment?
Most of what helps happens before the appointment, and almost none of it is a product.

Preparation is mostly subtraction. Anything you started in the last two weeks is a new variable sitting on top of the one being assessed. Recently tanned skin is a different starting point from the skin in your consultation photos. And irritated skin changes what is safe to do on the day.

This is not a research finding and there is no percentage attached to it. It is the preparation I ask for, and the reason behind each item is practical rather than statistical - fewer new variables, calmer skin, and a clinician who knows what is already on your face.

So three things, starting tonight. Write the list of everything on your face, including what you stopped. Pause the recent additions, not the whole routine. And protect the skin that is about to be assessed.

You are not preparing the skin. You are removing the unknowns.

General education only.
